classes.name: Hepatitis C direct-acting antivirals
classes.description: Sofosbuvir/velpatasvir (Epclusa and authorized generic), glecaprevir/pibrentasvir (Mavyret), ledipasvir/sofosbuvir (Harvoni and authorized generic), sofosbuvir/velpatasvir/voxilaprevir (Vosevi), elbasvir/grazoprevir (Zepatier).
classes.plainDescription: An 8 to 12 week course of pills that cures hepatitis C.

preferredAgent.sig: No cirrhosis or compensated cirrhosis: 1 tablet once daily for 12 weeks. Decompensated cirrhosis (Child-Pugh B or C): 1 tablet once daily plus weight-based ribavirin for 12 weeks (label).
preferredAgent.sigShort: 1 tab QD x12 wk (+ribavirin if decompensated)
preferredAgent.plainSig: One pill a day for 12 weeks; people with advanced liver scarring also take ribavirin.
